comparison.objective: Adjust a sliding rheostat to bring a bulb from 1 V to its rating; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilizing a free rheostat while continuously adjusting its slider using meter feedback versus coaxial impact tooling and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Hold 4.8–5.2 V for one second without exceeding 7 V versus four fractures, complete tang containment, no damage, and a two-second stable finish.
comparison.reason: The record tests feedback-regulated linear adjustment, not fracture at a manufactured notch. No separate spec versions were provided.
